## Research status

**Technical owners.** 2 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Stable Capability Fields](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/stable-capability-fields.html), [Capability Replacement and Rollback](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/capability-replacement-and-rollback.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 10.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Natural replacement studies showing no continuity, challenge, or recovery benefit beyond conventional versioning would weaken the abstraction.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
